The Solar System

The solar system consists of the Sun and everything bound to it by gravity. This includes the eight planets: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune. It includes dwarf planets, moons, comets, asteroids, and other celestial objects. The solar system is located in the Milky Way galaxy and is part of the Orion Arm.

All the planets and dwarf planets, the rocky asteroids, and the icy comets in the Kuiper Belt move in elliptical orbits around the Sun. This motion is called prograde motion.
